verdict.rationale: A GPU is not normally a data-insights product, but the evidence shows NVIDIA's ecosystem ships Project G-Assist, an AI assistant running on the RTX PC that "helps you tune, control, and optimize your system." That amounts to AI-generated suggestions drawn from system data, so the axis applies, but the support rests on one marketing line. Missing for 10: any description of the insights or suggestions G-Assist actually produces, support for the user's own data beyond system tuning, documentation depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
